0.141: Testing tools: in the Dungeon Lab, enemies now stand in the rooms; walking in starts the real fight, and the boss leads down to the next floor.
0.140: Testing tools: the Dungeon Lab now generates its floors (rooms, corridors, dead ends; N for a new one) and maps only what you have seen.
0.139: Testing tools: a first look at 3D dungeon exploration, a corridor to walk in debug mode (DUNGEON LAB). No gameplay changes.
0.137: Play stats: the owner can give each player a tester name, shown before the name they play under.
0.136: Under the hood: a review pass — a few rare bugs fixed (the benchmark now plays exactly the same fight on every machine, and can no longer cancel a descent that was still loading).
0.135: Testing tools: the benchmark now reads a battery-saver 30 fps cap correctly and records hitches instead of skipping them.
0.134: Fixed: a dialog left open in the Great Hall (like Descend Now?) could stay on screen over the benchmark.
0.133: Players who have reached room 10 are asked once to run a short (about 40 second) benchmark, which helps make the game run smoothly on every computer.
0.132: Fixed: blood splatters on the floor no longer flicker as they fade.
0.131: Testing tools: a BENCHMARK button in debug mode measures how smoothly the game runs on this computer.
0.130: Play stats now include how smoothly the game runs: frame rate per run, plus the device (graphics chip, browser, OS) — no personal data.
0.129: Smoother combat: the new particle effects draw much faster (batched rendering, smaller repaints, no hitch on a room's first hit), and thin out when a huge OVERKILL would flood the screen.
Fixed: stray pixel specks in the name field are gone for good, and letters like Å and Ö no longer lose their tops.
0.128: New combat particles: hits on flesh splash ink-dark blood that spatters onto the floor; bone, fire and spirit enemies burst into bright sparks with an impact ring (fire burns yellow and leaves floating cinders).
OVERKILL! now bursts particles out of every enemy it wipes.
0.127: Behind the scenes: testing tools update (no gameplay changes).
